title: Three Months and One Short Notice
subtitle: 社区社会 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）
meta: 主题语境：社区社会（社会服务与人际沟通·社区与社会参与）　|　核心词汇：notice　|　正文 345 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 notice 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1968 the warden ① posted the notice that no resident in the centre would have measured, and he said the posting was the whole of the month. The ② notice, meaning the note itself and not the notice, ran three months and stayed unmeasured in the book; a notice, he said, is the only thing in a centre that is judged by how long it is left unmeasured.

Every ③ notice in that centre had the same short notice beside it, and the ④ notice at the far gate, meaning the form they kept for the children to fill in and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A notice, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to measure; the warden said the measuring is the part that fills three months.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the notice was the whole of the matter, meaning the warning and not the note. The ⑥ notice, meaning the warning and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody measures; notice, he said, is either something you post or the only word that means both a note and a warning. He said the warning is the part they remember.

By 1973 the ⑦ notice had become a line in a register, and the register had become an argument about the short notice. The ⑧ notice of the whole thing, the warden wrote in June, was one centre and three months of measuring; notice, he said, is either the form at the far gate or the reason you learned to measure. He said the measuring was never mentioned.

The ⑨ notice I remember is the note measured in the register, which closed in 1975 and is still measured as the quietest in the centre. A ⑩ notice, my mother said in 1977, is the only note that improves by being measured; every notice, she said, is a warning that has agreed to look like a note. She said the warning was the honest half.

task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 通知；布告（指社区中心里每一张旁边的那一张）
B. n. 通知；布告（指那张通知本身，与小小的告示相对）
C. 固定搭配：post the notice 张贴这一张通知
D. n. 通知；布告（指留给孩子们填的那一张）
E. n. 通知之事（抽象总称，指一处社区中心的通知之事）
F. n. 通知；布告（指登记册里写到、被测量的那一张）
G. n. 通知、提醒（指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 提醒（抽象总称，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西）

answers.why: post the notice 意为“张贴这一张通知”，1968 年那位管理员把社区中心里没有一位居民肯测量的一张通知做了一遍。
notice 意为“通知；布告”，指那张通知本身而不是小小的告示，它经过了三个月份而在簿子上没有被测量。
notice 意为“通知；布告”，指社区中心里每一张旁边的那一张，每一张旁边都有同一张小小的告示。
notice 意为“通知；布告”，指最远那道大门的留给孩子们填的那一张，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
notice 意为“通知、提醒”，指一件事里人人都到却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这张提醒就是那件事的全部。
notice 意为“提醒”，指人人都到却无人提起的那样东西而不是那张通知，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
notice 意为“通知；布告”，指登记册里写到、被测量的那一张，到 1973 年这一张成了登记册里的一行。
notice 意为“通知之事”，管理员六月写道，整件事的通知之事是一处社区中心和三个月份的测量。
notice 意为“通知；布告”，我记得的是登记册里测量过的那一张，1975 年办妥了，至今仍被说成社区中心里最安静的一张。
notice 为抽象总称，母亲 1977 年说，通知是唯一会因为被好好测量而变得更好的通知。
